description:
Top Three Skills: 
 Web Services Experience
 CSL/XML Experience
 Documentation skills.
 Job Description: 
 Review and understand CSL code itself to understand what it does and how 
 Dialogue with the supporting CSL designers/architects 
 Work in a team environment 
 .net, JSON 
 Understands current CSL documentation (written docs, help pages, etc) 
 Ability to work as part of a high performance team 
 Airline reservation system experience helpful (understanding of terms, typical airline business rules, etc)
 
  Jr. C# developer 
 Looking for 2+ years experience 

 Must have Web Services experience, CSL/XML experience, and documentation. They are basically going to be analyzing this code and reverse engineering. 


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 to 12 Months
